bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
if ! docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 82; fi
if docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -q '^DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE=six_role$'; then exit 0; fi
if docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -q '^DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE=legacy$'; then exit 84; fi
exit 85
